spells.name: Land Mine
spells.observations: Three source-supported layers in one atlas. ROW1 four APPEARANCE frames: a tiny flat reddish-brown and bronze elliptical mechanical mine rim forms with small pale warm glints; no floor/background. ROW2 four STATIC MINE studies: the same tiny flat elliptical rim, identical position and appearance; only first will be exported as static hold because original idle is one frame. ROWS3–4 eight DETONATION frames: a small upright pale-hot cream flame puff with fine orange/red edge and tiny sharp glints, grows briefly, opens, thins and vanishes. Preserve source circular mine rim and soft narrow puff. No new area ring, crater, smoke blanket or ground cracks. Three roles stay separate, never render mine and puff together in any cell.
spells.motion_review: Original sheets and generated frame order, dark/light mattes and static scene peaks inspected. Browser playback blocked; generated temporal continuity and loop seams still need human playback review.

spells.name: Fire Wall
spells.observations: Three source-supported phases of ONE NARROW upright flame tongue, no ground plane. ROW1 four APPEAR frames: tiny embers become narrow red-orange flame column. ROWS2–3 eight SUSTAINED LOOP frames: same narrow column size/center, warm bright orange modeled interior, red-orange outer tongues; subtle continuous flame ripple, last loops into first. ROW4 four REMOVE frames: column thins to sparse embers then almost empty. Keep slim rounded-top flame tongue, never a wide wall panel, sheet of solid fire, enormous glow or sphere. All phases have same bottom alignment within their own cells; no effects touch other cells.

gaps.reason: Mapped original resource supplies a burst only. Mini travel is a separately user-requested Laema derivative, not extracted original flight.

spells.observations: Rounded turbulent original Fireball burst, pale-hot ignition and orange breakup. Earlier full/mini art preserved byte-for-byte.

spells.name: Inferno
spells.observations: A rounded turbulent orange-red flame CLOUD with an irregular pale cream scalloped outer envelope, softly modeled flame volume inside and darker russet pockets. Preserve the source's rounded puffy burst, visibly different from the tighter Fireball: a billowing envelope opening and dissolving. No spiral, pinwheel, radial shockwave, long tail or persistent field. Seed grows into cloud, hot patches roll, holes open, separated warm fragments dissolve. White remains concentrated, never a solid blinding disc.

spells.name: Armageddon
spells.observations: A rectangular PATCH OF MANY SEPARATE slender red-orange falling fire streaks, slanting consistently from upper right toward lower left as in source. Thin pale cream hottest centers, dark orange fringes, generous transparent gaps between streaks. Preserve the diagonal fire-rain pattern, not a sphere, mushroom explosion, circular impact, ground cracks or new meteor rocks. Sparse streaks appear, a modest dense middle patch of parallel fiery dashes, then thin back to scattered streaks and empty. The patch stays compact within the central60% of every cell; no streak enters neighboring cells. Targeted separated-streak repair selected; earlier connected version retained as rejected-connected-streaks.png.

Appears from sparse warm motes, holds shield/flames through middle, disperses into sparks.

spells.name: Sacrifice
spells.observations: Two separate source-supported manifestations. ROWS1–2 eight PRIMARY frames: a small grey translucent smoky sphere with two bright white curved interlocking inner figure-like echoes, matching source symbolism. Small restrained red-orange accents at perimeter only; preserve grey-white inner form. Appears, shows curved echoes, dissipates. ROWS3–4 eight SECONDARY frames: a small sharp pale-hot starburst/annulus with a clean central hole, warm cream body and orange-red rim, matching the other source. Opens, thins into a few spokes/fragments, then vanishes. No new character, skeleton, corpse, beam linking layers, fireball or gameplay action. Keep both manifestations in separate cells, never combined.

spells.name: Curse

Sequence stippled appearance, fully formed wand and skull, red droplets during middle frames, then wand and shower dissipate.
